summary: Only source found is the Forest Fire Lookout Association register, which lists a Tripoli tower in Oneida County as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone in the Forest Fire Lookout Association register; no other source found

evidence.supports: the register lists a tower at Tripoli in Oneida County, marked gone, with its coordinates

notes_for_editor: Register-only record. No build date, staffing, fate detail or site description was found. The Wikipedia article for Tripoli has no tower mention. A realtor.com property-records page lists a road named Fire Tower Rd in Tripoli (https://www.realtor.com/local/property-records/wisconsin/oneida-county/tripoli/fire-tower-rd). A road name is not evidence of a tower and was not used; it may help a local search for the site. The story is well under the 120-word floor for the same reason as Thunder Lake.
